description: This file is a PHP source code defining the Approval class within the Opencart\'s Catalog\Model\Account namespace. It contains methods for managing customer approval entries, such as adding and deleting approvals.

classes.name: Approval
classes.description: Represents customer approval management, providing methods to add and delete approval entries in the database.

methods.name: addApproval
methods.description: Inserts a new customer approval record into the database with the specified customer ID and type.

methods.name: deleteApprovals
methods.description: Deletes all approval records for a given customer ID from the database.
